heard: Astronomers beamed a cosmic greeting to an empty target. Astronomer Frank Drake broadcast a three-minute transmission from Puerto Rico in 1974. Carl Sagan helped encode 1,679 radio pulses into a grid. Decoded, the pixels showed numbers, human DNA, and our solar system. The signal targeted a massive cluster 25,000 light years away. Any alien answer would take 50,000 years to return. But that star cluster orbits the center of our galaxy. When the broadcast arrives, those stars will have moved away. We really did beam a greeting to an empty target.
